title: Junction Named to the 2026 New York Digital Health 100
body_markdown: We’re proud to share that **Junction** has been named to the **2026 New York Digital Health 100 (DH100)** — an annual list recognizing the most innovative and high-impact digital health startups in the New York region. Published by[Digital Health New York](https://www.dhny.co/) , the DH100 is featured in the *2026 New York Healthcare Innovation Report* , which highlights the companies and trends shaping the future of healthcare. Now in its seventh year, the list reflects a clear shift across the industry: from experimentation to execution. At Junction, we’re building infrastructure that makes lab testing and health data work more like software — embedded, reliable, and scalable. Being recognized alongside this year’s DH100 cohort reinforces the importance of foundational tools that support better care delivery, clearer operations, and improved patient experiences. We’re grateful to the DHNY team for the recognition and proud to be included among companies tackling some of healthcare’s most complex challenges with practical, production-ready solutions. 👉[View the full DH100 list and download the 2026 New York Healthcare Innovation Report](https://static1.squarespace.com/static/62c854a63c491014a5fa45ce/t/69826e3128a2d061413f03a0/1770155569528/DHNY+2026+New+York+Healthcare+Innovation+Report.pdf) **.** We’re excited to continue building alongside healthcare operators, digital health platforms, and partners who believe infrastructure matters.
